Row.Text: Lars Porsenna, lucumo of Clusium, the Etruscan king who besieged Rome and whose works Pliny could hardly believe.

+3 [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production in Cities, +2 [icon:YIELD_SCIENCE] Science and +2 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness in all Settlements, and Buildings cost 15% less [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold to purchase. Districts with a Fortification have +30 Health, units defending one of your Districts have +4 [icon:COMBAT] Combat Strength, and your units have +5 [icon:COMBAT] Combat Strength when attacking a District.
Porsenna measures a neighbour by what stands in their cities. He respects leaders whose Districts are well built up, and thinks little of those who leave them empty.
Bring me the surveyors before you bring me the army.
